attacks.name: Mace Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Hoof Quake
steps: |!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: God Crusher
steps: After this attack is resolved, it the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a move action immediately followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: You‘re Going to Have to Deal With Me First
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of Range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.
